# Kro

> Control your time, do not let time control you.

Kro is a personal execution system: Plan, Do and Earn, in one place. You plan
your days and weeks, work through them in focused sessions, and see what your
time actually earned.

## Platforms

- Web: an installable app (PWA) at https://hub.kroapp.com
- Native apps for Apple platforms and Android — see the landing page for
  availability and early access

## Canonical URLs

- Landing page: https://kroapp.com/
- Pricing: https://kroapp.com/pricing
- The app: https://hub.kroapp.com/ (kroapp.com/hub redirects there)

## Privacy

Kro's analytics record counts and timings only — never the words you write.
